svg.aria-label: Status-triage signal press for the 23 November 2026 Atlassian MCP server outage (15:19 to 20:45 UTC, 5 hours 26 minutes). A connection token rides a carriage under a press gantry while three checks sort the failure: the MCP component cell's status lamp lit orange, an unauthenticated probe dial whose probe tip touches the token, and a scope gauge with its needle in a narrow band. The single v2 endpoint socket stands at back-right, and the reconnect crank rests parked with its stop pin in, because reconnecting fixes nothing while the component is down. Numbers: 3 checks, 1 v2 endpoint, 0 reconnect fixes.
svg.text: NOV 23 · 15:19–20:45 UTC · 5H26M · 3 CHECKS · 1 V2 ENDPOINT · 0 RECONNECT FIXES
